title: Conduct stakeholder workshops for the customer self-service portal
description: Run discovery sessions with Sales, Support and Finance to capture current pain points and must-have features. Get product owner sign-off on the requirements document.

title: Define acceptance criteria for order tracking and invoice download user stories
description: Split epics into user stories with Given/When/Then criteria, covering edge cases like cancelled orders and partial shipments. Review with QA.

title: Create high-fidelity Figma designs for the dashboard and order details screens
description: Design responsive layouts using the company design system, meeting WCAG 2.1 AA. Validate the clickable prototype with pilot customers.

title: Design the database schema and entity relationships for orders and invoices
description: Model Customer, Order, Shipment and Invoice entities with keys and indexes. Produce an ER diagram and migration script for DBA review.

title: Implement OAuth 2.0 login with Azure AD B2C and role-based access control
description: Integrate Azure AD B2C sign-in and validate JWT tokens on every API call. Map claims to Customer and Support Agent roles.

title: Build REST endpoints for order history with pagination, filtering and sorting
description: Develop order endpoints with status and date filters and sorting. Ensure customers only see their own orders and document in OpenAPI.

title: Develop PDF invoice generation and secure download service
description: Generate branded PDF invoices on demand and store them in Blob Storage. Serve downloads through short-lived SAS links.

title: Write automated API regression suite and integrate it into the CI pipeline
description: Create pytest tests for auth, orders and invoice download. Run them on every pull request and block merges on failure.

title: Execute load and performance testing for peak month-end traffic
description: Simulate 2,000 concurrent users with JMeter. Target p95 response time under 800 ms with less than 0.5% errors.

title: Perform user acceptance testing with pilot customers and track defects
description: Run a one-week UAT with five pilot customers and triage issues daily. Share a go/no-go summary with the release board.

title: Provision staging and production infrastructure using Bicep templates
description: Write Bicep templates for App Service, Azure SQL, Storage and Key Vault. Use managed identity and keep secrets in Key Vault.

title: Configure blue-green production release with automated rollback
description: Use deployment slots to smoke-test before swapping to production. Configure health alerts and a five-minute rollback procedure.

title: Publish OpenAPI documentation and developer onboarding guide
description: Host interactive API docs from the OpenAPI spec. Write an onboarding guide covering local setup, testing and coding conventions.

title: Prepare end-user help centre articles and support runbook
description: Write help articles for tracking orders and downloading invoices. Create a Support runbook with common issues and escalation paths.

title: Record release notes and conduct post-launch retrospective
description: Publish release notes with new features and known limitations. Hold a team retrospective two weeks after launch.
